variants.name: g1-joint-view-consistent
variants.prompt: Use the supplied image as the sole, immutable ROBOT IDENTITY MASTER. Produce one high-resolution transparent PNG asset of THIS EXACT SAME ROBOT, not a newly designed robot. Identity lock: preserve the long narrow rounded black visor with its thin silver rim, the exact neck stack, single smooth pentagonal chest shell with four exposed black fasteners and rounded lower chest edge, the curved silver hip shell, cylindrical shoulder/elbow/hip/knee joints, tapered shin shells, the same five-finger hands and compact wedge-shaped feet. Preserve all proportions, shell segmentation, fastener placement, materials, mechanical details and lighting character. Do not copy the dark backdrop visible in a viewer: deliver real alpha transparency, no backdrop, no floor, no glow, no halo, no shadow outside the body, no labels or text. Full body including head, hands and feet inside the canvas with safe transparent margins. The reference image is a neutral frontal product render. Make a COLOR-ONLY VARIANT of the supplied neutral frontal A-pose. Keep the robot's outline, exact pose, camera, head, hands, feet, geometry and every mechanical part unchanged. Change ONLY the outer body-shell paint: torso/chest, waist, pelvis and both leg shells COBALT BLUE; shoulder shell caps, both upper-arm and forearm shells AMBER ORANGE. Retain dark joint mechanisms and original silver head rim. All fasteners and original shell seams stay in exactly their current positions. This should look like the identical photograph with different shell paint, not a redesign.
